content: From April 6, 2019, the minimum contribution to the GitLab UK pension scheme is 5% of basic salary from the team member and 4% of basic salary from GitLab [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
- From April 6, 2019 to a minimum of:
  - Team Member: 5% of basic salary
  - GitLab: 4% of basic salary

- As your contribution is a percentage of your pay, the amounts will automatically increase or decrease in accordance with your basic pay. These contributions will be taken from your pay and will include tax relief.

- You may increase your contribution percentage by contacting the Non-US Payroll team via [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request). The company contribution will remain fixed as outlined above. The standard **Annual Allowance** applies to all contributions (employer and employee) made to the pension plan in a tax year. Unused allowance may be carried forward for up to three tax years. Current rates are published on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates). Your Annual Allowance may be reduced if your Adjusted Income exceeds the threshold limit (current rates available on the [HMRC Pension Schemes rates page](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-pension-schemes/pension-schemes-rates)), or if you 'flexibly access' benefits from a Defined Contribution pension arrangement. See the [Annual Allowance Fact Sheet](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MMA-0wfzUsO70pBsweDAHK-FVc-P_iR1/view?usp=sharing) for details.

[2] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
- **For Team Membewrs on Relief at Source Only**: These percentages are gross percentages using the [relief at source](https://www.gov.uk/workplace-pensions/managing-your-pension) method. As basic rate tax relief is then added by the pension provider, the amount on your payslip will typically be the net amount, which is 80% of the employee’s contribution.

These contribution percentages are in line with [The Pension Regulator’s Auto-enrollment legislation](https://www.thepensionsregulator.gov.uk/en/document-library/automatic-enrolment-detailed-guidance). Should the government’s minimum contribution standards change further GitLab will contact you to advise the new levels to comply with legislation.

Opting Out

If you decide to opt out of the scheme you can do this within one month of the enrollment date by following the instructions in the information from Scottish Widows. The Opt Out deadlines are:

[3] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Income Protection]
Provides 66% of your base salary if you cannot work due to illness or injury, plus vocational rehabilitation support.

Eligibility Requirements

- All team members aged 16 to State Pension Age
- After State Pension Age, team members are enrolled in an Extended Cover Policy up to age 70.
- Automatic enrollment upon hire

Coverage & Key Features

- 66% of base salary after 13 weeks absence
- Vocational rehabilitation consultants to support your return to work
- Holistic wellbeing and absence management services
- View the [Unum Employee Guide to Claims](https://www.unum.co.uk/claims/group-income-protection/employee-guide-to-claims)

How to Access

- The Leaves team will reach out at week 6 of absence to initiate the claim process
- If you have questions before then, contact the Leaves team via [Compass](https://app.serval.com/new-request)
- Payments made like regular salary with standard tax deductions

Medical Underwriting

- The automatic cover threshold for the Group Income Protection policy is 66.6% of salary.
- Underwriting: Based on the current non-medical limit of £155,000, the base salary threshold above which medical underwriting is required is £232,732 (i.e., £155,000 ÷ 66.6%).
- Higher salaries require medical assessment for additional coverage

[4] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > Denmark 🇩🇰]
**Key Features**

- Team member contribution: 4% of monthly base salary
- Employer contribution: 8% of monthly base salary
- The pension contribution includes retirement savings, insurance, and administration fees
- Contributions paid directly to pension plan with monthly salary
- Team members will be contacted by TopDanmark when joining GitLab to discuss their options

 Denmark Life & Disability Insurance
Team Members in Denmark have access to Life, Disability and Critical Illness insurance through their pension administered by TopDanmark. Team members have the option to adjust their coverage within the following limits:

- Life Insurance: Up to 300% salary
- Loss of earning capacity/disability coverage: up to 60% salary
- Critical Illness insurance: up to DKK 800,000
- TopDanmark will reach out to each team member to discuss their options and confirm their elected benefit limits.

 Denmark Statutory Leave Policies

Below is the information related to Denmark's statutory leave policies. Please note that team members hired in Denmark are hired via GX (PEO) and you should always check with GX first for the most up to date information.

**Denmark Holiday Leave**

- All full-time workers are entitled to 5 weeks (25 days) paid holiday leave a year under the Holiday Act (Lov om ferie).
- The holiday year runs from 1 September to 31 August, and any accrued holidays can be taken until 31 December of the following year, allowing a total period of 16 months to utilise the leave.

[5] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Pension Scheme]
GitLab provides a Group Personal Pension Plan with Scottish Widows, helping you build financial security for retirement.

Eligibility Requirements

Automatic enrollment if you:

- Earn over £10,000 annually
- Are aged 22 or over
- Are under State Pension Age

If an employee does not meet these criteria then they will be considered an Entitled Worker (earn less than £6,240 p.a) or a Non-Eligible Jobholder (earn between £6,240 and £10,000 p.a).

Entitled workers must be offered the opportunity to join the pension scheme. They can make contributions to the pension scheme if they choose. However, there is no requirement for GitLab to make a contribution.

Non-Eligible jobholders must be offered the opportunity to opt in to an automatic enrollment scheme.

 Coverage & Key Features

- GitLab contributes 4% of your basic salary
- You contribute 5% of your basic salary (minimum)
- Annual Management Charge: 0.54%
- Tax relief on your contributions (20-45% depending on tax band)
- Over 50 fund options available
- Salary sacrifice option available (saving on National Insurance)
- Watch the [2025 UK Pension Webinar](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZUXJLK3v_m96yUUOpsNkX2Skh7ScdKuI/view) and review the [presentation](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qXAIOTTMavV0pxbj6Hxm0y2k39MoJ6Rz/view) for an overview of the UK Pension System
- View the [Company Pension Plan FAQ](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BEADGm7sUbroEkxzGvB-DBIhMIbbLG46/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

[6] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Paternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Statutory Paternity Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of 26 weeks of continuous service is abolished.
- Team members can receive Statutory Paternity Pay for up to 2 weeks or up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- Eligible team members are entitled to £194.32 or 90% of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for up to 2 weeks OR up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary
- Leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the child's birth

How to Apply

- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave Category) 30+ days before start
- Send completed [SPP Form](https://www.tax.service.gov.uk/print-and-post/form/PersonalTax_iForms/1.0/SC3/sc3.xdp) or one of the [SPL Forms](https://www.acas.org.uk/shared-parental-leave-form-templates) to leaves@gitlab.com
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the form, dates of leave and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc).
